payload.description_html:
A fossil Archaeopteryx Lithographica, taken on 2007-05-18 in the Staatliches Museum für Naturkunde in Karlsruhe, Germany. This is claimed to be the well-preserved Thermopolis Specimen. This version shows how the whole slab was mounted in a glass showcase.

Image taken by User:Stephan Schulz.

See Image:Archaeopterix ka01.jpg for more details and other versions.
